meta.title: EU Safety Gate alerts for passenger cars (snapshot)
meta.licence: CC0 1.0 as listed on data.europa.eu for the weekly XML reports; pictures are not copied.
meta.scope: Alerts that EU/EEA authorities published in Safety Gate under 'Motor vehicles' whose product is a passenger car, passenger van or camper van. Safety Gate does not say whether a car was sold in Finland; Finnish recalls are in Traficom's database (see car-running-costs.json → recalls).

fields.week: date of the weekly report that published the alert
fields.makes: brand(s), split and normalised by us (e.g. 'VW' → 'Volkswagen', 'Citroen, Ds' → ['Citroën', 'DS']); empty if Safety Gate gives none
fields.models: Safety Gate 'name', cut at 200 characters (… marks a cut)
fields.type: type / type-approval numbers, cut at 80 characters (sometimes the only place the model is named)
fields.production: production dates as Safety Gate gives them, cut at 200 characters
fields.years: [first, last] year found in 'production' (yearsBasis 'production') or in the description's 'Model years' (yearsBasis 'modelYears'); our parsing, null if none
fields.summary: first sentence of Safety Gate's 'danger' text (cut at 300 characters)
fields.measures: measure categories, e.g. 'Recall of the product from end users'
fields.alert: Safety Gate alert number; link = urlPattern with {alert} replaced
